BrickDrop 1.3.0 makes disc-image routing more accurate and the SD-card cleanup more robust.

What's changed:
- Routing now matches system names as whole words, so `business.iso` or `DCollection.iso` are no longer misrouted, while names like `dmg-game.chd` and `DC_Sonic.chd` are recognised.
- A `.bin` is treated as part of a CUE disc set only when a matching CUE exists (same name, or `(Track N)` / `(Disc N)` variants), so unrelated CUE files in the same folder no longer send it to PlayStation.
- `dot_clean` now has a timeout. A hung or output-holding run is stopped and reported as an error instead of leaving the app stuck at "working".
- Expanded test coverage for copy skip/overwrite behaviour, metadata cleanup (including symlink safety), and `.m3u`/CUE reference resolution.
- CI now runs `swift build` and `swift test` on every pull request.

Requirements:
- Apple silicon Mac (arm64)
- macOS 14 Sonoma or later

This build is ad-hoc signed but not Apple-notarized. macOS may require Control-click → Open on first launch.
